content:
Support Sam: heads up — customer acme-inc reports that their Private VPC dashboard shows 0 traffic for the last 24h. They say API calls succeed but console charts are empty.

Alice Zhang: can you paste the error from the ingest service or a request id? any 4xx/5xx in the private proxy logs?

Support Sam: from their support bundle — metrics-ingest returns 403 for the batch:
```
{"ts":"2024-11-05T14:12:03Z","request_id":"req-e7b9","path":"/v1/private/metrics/ingest","status":403,"msg":"tenant auth failed"}
```
Also they included a curl repro: 
```
curl -v -X POST https://private.example.net/v1/private/metrics/ingest \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -H "X-Redwood-Tenant: acct-acme-01" \n  -d '{"series": [...] }'
```
Response body: `{"error":"tenant mismatch"}`

Ben Ortiz: quick theory — the private proxy introduced a change last night to normalize headers and we might be stripping custom tenant headers before proxying to ingest. I see a recent PR that touched the nginx->upstream header handling.

Carmen Li: I pulled the infra logs: proxy-nginx on the customer's private mesh had this patch: `proxy_set_header X-Redwood-Tenant "";` (intended to clear client IP header) — looks like it zeroes the tenant header. That would cause ingest to fall back to JWT-sub validation which fails for these tokens.

Alice Zhang: thanks. if the tenant header is missing, the backend checks token sub vs header and rejects if they don't align. We rely on either X-Redwood-Tenant OR a JWT claim `tenant_id`. Some customers send tenant in header for sidecars that rewrap tokens.

Support Sam: repro steps I used locally: start a local private-proxy with the offending nginx config, then forward a request with valid X-Redwood-Tenant and token. The header is dropped and ingest replies 403.

Ben Ortiz: suggested immediate mitigation: re-add forwarding of the header in the proxy config. In nginx syntax: `proxy_set_header X-Redwood-Tenant $http_x_redwood_tenant;` — or remove the line that clears it. We should push a hotfix to the private-proxy image and coordinate with the customer.

Carmen Li: confirming — rolling back the config on a staging instance fixes charts. I also found a related bug: when the header is present but empty string we still reject, so some edge cases remain.

Support Sam: what about short-term customer remediation? Can we accept auth solely via JWT for them? They said their sidecar injects header and the token is opaque.

Alice Zhang: short term we can patch ingest to fallback to a tenant mapping table via token hash for that customer, but that's invasive. Better: we tell customer to roll back proxy change or we push the proxy hotfix.

infra-bot: deploys/private-proxy/staging rollback started by Carmen. (job id: deploy-8823) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Carmen Li: started rollback to previous nginx template for their VPC. Once it's rolled, metrics should start arriving within a minute (ingest processes batch backfill).

Support Sam: I messaged the customer with the rollback ETA and asked for a quick smoke check. They replied: `ok let us know` — no panic. :slightly_smiling_face:

Ben Ortiz: follow-up action items: 1) add an integration test that ensures X-Redwood-Tenant is preserved by proxy, 2) patch nginx template to avoid clearing custom headers, 3) add monitoring alert for 4xx rate on /v1/private/metrics/ingest per VPC.

Alice Zhang: I'll own the integration test and the ingest fallback review. Carmen can own the proxy template change. Support Sam please capture repro steps and attach the customer bundle to the ticket.

Support Sam: noted — attaching logs + curl. I'll update the ticket and close once rollback confirmed. :thumbsup:
